name: Investigate the Blue Recluse
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
A disturbance has been reported at the Blue Recluse tavern in the Mage Quarter.  Strange, invisible creatures now wander the tavern, and I fear a mana rift has formed there.

I want you to investigate the tavern and capture those creatures.  Use the cantation of manifestation in the tavern to make the creatures visible, subdue them then use a containment coffer to capture them.  When you have enough, return to me with your filled coffers, your empty coffers and the cantation.
narrative.objectives: Obtain a Cantation of Manifestation and a Chest of Containment coffers from behind Jennea Cannon.  Bring 3 Filled Containment Coffers to Jennea at the Wizard's Sanctum.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Very well done!  I will study these creatures and, with diligence and luck, determine how they slipped into our world.

Your value to the society of mages grows, adventurer.
narrative.requestItemsText: Have you captured the creatures, adventurer?  They must be studied in order to determine the reason behind their arrival.
